dataset: Author-created synthetic audit scenarios, not hidden jury profiles or observed employee outcomes
comparison: Each budget is planned independently. Live provider is called separately per nonempty fixture/budget; compare paired rows with identical fixture and budget.
limitations: Synthetic fixtures do not establish real engagement or hidden-jury accuracy.
The independent exhaustive oracle measures achievable gap reduction and duration, not learner preference.
Calendar planning has day precision and minimum physical duration; real availability is not known.
Same step budget is not the same learning duration; both are reported.
Provider fallbacks remain visible and are not counted as successful AI calls.
